titulo: Regular -er and -ir verbs in the imperfect
subtitulo: De niño comía tacos y vivía en Rosarito.
regla: Regular -er and -ir verbs share one set of imperfect endings: drop -er/-ir and add -ía, -ías, -ía, -íamos, -ían (comía, vivía). Every form carries an accent on the í.

bloques.texto: To form the imperfect of a regular **-er** or **-ir** verb, drop the ending and add **-ía**. Both groups use **exactly the same endings**.
**Every** form has a written accent on the **í**, including **nosotros**: **comíamos**, **vivíamos**.
**Yo** and **él / ella / usted** look the same (**comía**). Add the subject when it isn't clear from context.

Almost every -er/-ir verb is regular here, even ones that are irregular in other tenses: **tener → tenía**, **hacer → hacía**, **poder → podía**, **querer → quería**, **salir → salía**. Only **ser**, **ir** and **ver** break the pattern.
Tip: -ar verbs hum **-aba**; -er and -ir verbs sing **-ía**. Never mix them.

lista.es: De niño ==vivía== en Rosarito, a dos cuadras de la playa.
lista.en: As a kid I lived in Rosarito, two blocks from the beach.

lista.es: Los domingos ==comíamos== en casa de mi abuela.
lista.en: On Sundays we used to eat at my grandma's house.
Where did you live before you moved to Tijuana?

lista.es: Mi papá ==tenía== un taller mecánico en la Libertad.
lista.en: My dad had a mechanic's shop in La Libertad.

lista.es: Al principio no ==entendía== nada en las clases de jiu-jitsu.
lista.en: At first I didn't understand anything in jiu-jitsu class.

lista.es: Mis primos ==salían== a surfear todos los fines de semana.
lista.en: My cousins used to go out surfing every weekend.

lista.es: En la prepa ==leía== mucha ciencia ficción.
lista.en: In high school I read a lot of science fiction.

lista.es: El huerto ==tenía== tres limoneros y muchas hierbas.
lista.en: The garden had three lemon trees and lots of herbs.

filas.t: Comiamos tacos de birria cada sábado.
Comíamos tacos de birria cada sábado.

lista.nota: The accent goes on the **í**, not the a.

lista.texto: The -ar version: [[5263|-ar verbs in the imperfect]].
The only irregular ones: [[5268|ver]], [[5088|ser]] and [[5269|ir]] in the imperfect.
Don't mix it with the preterite: [[5230|-er and -ir verbs in the preterite]].
What it's for: [[5111|the imperfect for habits in the past]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _We used to live in Ensenada._
In Spanish: _You (tú) used to eat a lot of fish._
Fix it: _Mis amigos bebíamos agua de jamaica._
lista.r: Mis amigos bebían agua de jamaica.
